episodes.title: Breakfast Wrap: Victoria heads to the polls

stories.angle: The Coalition holds a significant lead heading into the Victorian election, and Labor is facing potential disaster.
stories.voices: Raf Epstein, ABC Melbourne Host (live); Peter Dutton, Opposition Leader (clip); Daniel Andrews, Victorian Premier (clip).
stories.tone: Analytical, urgent, and focused on electoral stakes.
stories.emphasis: Polling numbers, political strategy, and potential electoral outcomes.
stories.placement: Lead item, extensive coverage compared to other segments.
stories.evidence: the polling companies would have to have made the biggest mistake in history to have gotten this one wrong

stories.angle: Federal Parliament's lower house sets out to pass the government's gas reservation scheme.
stories.voices: Raf Epstein, ABC Melbourne Host (live); Madeleine King, Minister for Resources (clip).
stories.emphasis: Downward pressure on prices for industry and consumers.
stories.evidence: making sure that gas exporters provide into the Australian market so that there is that downward pressure on prices

stories.story: Interview with Victorian Premier Ben Carroll
stories.angle: Ben Carroll defends Labor's record and outlines his vision for Victoria amid tough political headwinds.
stories.voices: Sach Babylon-Gat, Host (live); Lucy Tassel, Host (live); Ben Carroll, Premier of Victoria (live).
stories.emphasis: Integrity, community safety, education, and economic management.
stories.evidence: (paraphrase) My first press conference, I called a Royal Commission into the construction sector and that's up and running.
